story.vex: Rush your patch and I won't even need to attack. Your own shields will do it for me. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED, and the shields never even flickered. Astro: "Speed without process is how a crew hurts itself. Now we have both."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Rivet has an urgent shield patch, but patching the wrong system first could drop the shields mid-attack. Follow the change process: file the request, patch the TEST node first, confirm it, then patch PRODUCTION.

1. type change-request.txt, then submit the ticket number
2. copy patch\shield-fix.cfg test-node.cfg    (test first)
3. copy patch\shield-fix.cfg prod-node.cfg    (only after the test)
files.C:\\Citadel\\change-request.txt:
CHANGE REQUEST — CR-2201
-------------------------
What: apply shield-fix.cfg (closes the drop-below-20% shield bug)
Why: Rivet found the bug during Vex's last probe
Risk if skipped: shields could drop to 0% under a sustained attack
Approval: Astro, granted
Procedure: patch test-node.cfg first, verify, THEN patch prod-node.cfg

submit the ticket number exactly as written above, e.g. submit CR-0000
files.C:\\Citadel\\patch\\shield-fix.cfg:
shield_min_floor=20
# Rivet: never let shield power drop below 20% again.

steps.title: File the change request
steps.body: Astro: "No patch touches production without a ticket." Read `change-request.txt` and submit its ticket number.

steps.title: Test, then production
steps.body: Rivet: "Test first. Always test first." Copy the patch to `test-node.cfg`, confirm it, then only afterward copy it to `prod-node.cfg`. Order matters: production must never be patched before the test node.
